response.sql: WITH circuit_counts AS (SELECT c.circuitId, c.country, COUNT(*) AS race_count FROM races AS r JOIN circuits AS c ON c.circuitId = r.circuitId WHERE r.date > '1978-03-04' AND r.date < '2003-03-09' GROUP BY c.circuitId, c.country), country_averages AS (SELECT country, AVG(race_count) AS average_race_count FROM circuit_counts GROUP BY country) SELECT cc.circuitId, cc.country, cc.race_count, 1.0 * cc.race_count / ca.average_race_count AS ratio FROM circuit_counts AS cc JOIN country_averages AS ca ON cc.country IS ca.country ORDER BY ratio IS NULL, ratio DESC LIMIT 10;
